notes:
Summary: PixelForge builds a VS Code copilot extension aimed at enterprise dev teams (internal tools + platform SDKs). Primary ask: sub-50ms incremental suggestions inside the editor with streaming token deltas and deterministic model pinning for reproducibility. They want a flow where the extension opens a websocket/SSE and receives token deltas to render inline suggestions as user types — low jitter is critical.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Latency target: median <35ms for incremental tokens in NA/EU; 95th <120ms.
- Throughput: typical workspace 50 concurrent editors; POC synthetic target 500 rps across Dedicated pool.
- Streaming: need server-initiated incremental patches (diffs) rather than full-message replacements to minimize UI flicker.
- Auth: ephemeral workspace-scoped tokens; integrate with SSO/SAML for enterprise customers; per-user and workspace-level rate limits; token revocation support.
- Model/versioning: require model pinning (semver-like labels) + automated fallback to quantized variant when cost or capacity requires it; ability to pin to exact model sha for audits.
- Caching: local prefix caching + server-side KV cache for common repo patterns suggested.
- Observability: trace per-suggestion latency breakdown, token-cost at token-level, and per-route cost charts for billing.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence, DPA signed, support for EU data residency and optional on-prem/private deployment for customers in regulated industries.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- "We need the suggestions to feel live — any visible lag kills adoption."
- "If we switch model versions and get different behaviors, PMs will revolt; need model pinning & rollback policy."

POC plan highlights:
- 2-week POC using Dedicated nodes in NA + EU; run three canonical repos (frontend, infra, SDK) with real dev flows. Collect latency, suggestion acceptance rate, and cost per 1k suggestions.
- Run rate-limit scenarios: per-user burst to 20 rps, workspace-wide limit enforcement, and graceful 429/queued responses demo.
- Security: validate SSO SAML flow, key rotation with KMS, and audit log delivery to SIEM (sample forwarder).

Next steps / owner actions:
- AE (Samira): share pricing scenarios and send DPA to legal.
- SE (Diego): schedule Dedicated perf run with infra (target week of 2025-02-24).
- Security (Priya): schedule pen-test window and confirm SOC2 artifacts to share.

Short-term blockers: SSO metadata (customer) not provided; legal wants DPA before Dedicated activation; product wants to confirm streaming API contract for token-delta messages.

Staging notes: trial extension likely if PoC shows median <40ms and cost per 1k suggestions < $12.
